# FENICON

> FENICON is a Belgium-based Microsoft-focused consulting company helping organizations get the most out of Microsoft 365, Copilot and Power Platform, with a focus on governance, security and real business value.

## Services

- [Microsoft Copilot & Copilot Studio Consulting](https://fenicon.be/copilot/): Readiness, governance and Copilot Studio agents to introduce Microsoft Copilot in a practical, secure and scalable way.
- [Power Platform Consulting & Governance](https://fenicon.be/power-platform/): Business applications and automation with Power Apps, Power Automate and Dataverse, with architecture and governance built in from the start.
- [Microsoft 365 Workplace Consulting](https://fenicon.be/microsoft-365/): A modern, governed workplace around Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive and Microsoft 365 that supports both users and IT.
- [Automation & Microsoft Graph Integration](https://fenicon.be/automation/): PowerShell, Microsoft Graph and API-driven automation to make administration and business processes faster and easier to govern.
